system.description:
Dwarven Artificers learn a special art of inscribing runes into stone. These runes can be carved into walls for decorative or instructional purposes or placed onto blocks, dipped in ink and pressed on paper.

Obstacles: Simple characters, Ob 1. Words, Ob 2. Simple image or moon runes, Ob 3. Complex image, Ob 4. Lifelike image, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Dwarven Rune Script, Symbology, Engraving, Dye Manufacture

Skill Type: Artisan. Tools: Workshop.

Restrictions: Dwarves only

Root: Per/Agi (§ magical skill: tests are open-ended)

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 281
